data.body: MCP reachability is no longer a capability gate (2026-10-14; servers like the Unreal Editor are closed/opened all day). Before, a Chat whose server was down at start never offered its tools: the first-input freeze dropped the binding and every later pass re-dropped it. Now discover_workflow_mcp freezes a manifest for every prepared connection whether or not the session opened and falls back to preview_mcp_definitions (saved Settings catalog, enabled tools only) for unreachable servers; a connection that could not be prepared at all (missing credential, unverified pin) is still dropped with a warning; RestoredFrozenMcpV1 has no unavailable list and service.rs keeps every frozen MCP binding. McpToolRuntimeV1::invoke now returns McpDispatchErrorV1 (Unreachable|Rejected) so run_mcp_tool names the outage and asks the model to start the server; the next call reconnects. cargo test --lib 631 passed; design aworkit.trusted_core + snapshot_freezer updated. Not verified: real Unreal MCP E2E.
